description: Before you write a transform, search or list the public fixture programs (sort/dedup/json/csv/case/date/extract…), authored oracles, and composites. With q, in, out, family, limit or all=true it is a search, ranked as the library's own search page ranks and the same as GET /api/v1/programs?q=…: one row per family, best first, each with its family, how many variants matched and their class_ids, and the query read back with how many tools matched. With none of them (or only all=false), every row, sorted by class_id. A bad value is an error result that says which and why; an array, an object or null is a bad value. Each row has class_id, iface, input_kind, radius, the run price (¢0.1) and a purpose: what it does, what to give it, what you get, an example, its family, and whether a step in it does nothing (pointless). class_id returns the full artifact instead. Free; nothing is run; no user text in any program; a purpose's what may be a request's own sentence (third-party data).

all.description: true: chains with a step that does nothing are returned too (hidden by default; `hidden` counts them)

class_id.description: Optional: the full artifact for this class (the search arguments are not read then)

family.description: One family's key, as a row's `family` gives it (`lines_deduped+lines_sorted`): only its members. An unknown family returns no rows

in.description: The kind of value you have: only tools that take it (or a wider kind) are returned; one that takes exactly it ranks first

limit.description: Rows (families) returned, 50 by default, 200 at most

out.description: The kind of value you want back: only tools that give it are returned (a count is a number)

q.description: What the tool should do, in words ("remove duplicate lines", "count words"); ranked by the words a tool's purpose, name, id and steps hold, less its steps no word asks for. At most 200 characters (spaces folded), its first 12 different words read; words such as "the" alone match nothing

name: programs
title: Verified program catalog (free)
